families.label: Education Program Delivery
families.definition: Operation and delivery of formal higher education, career and technical education, and primary or secondary education programs and institutions.

capabilities.label: Higher education program delivery
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to design, authorize, deliver, assess, and support postsecondary degree, certificate, credit, or continuing education programs.

capabilities.label: Career and technical education delivery
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to deliver structured occupational, trade, technical, licensure, or career preparation programs with instruction and assessment.

capabilities.label: Primary and secondary education delivery
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate and deliver formal elementary or secondary education programs with curriculum, instruction, assessment, and student support.
